discovery_notes: Follow-up 1 of B010. 30 standard WebSearch queries, all search_snippet, blocked domains passed every time. Mainly Disney Pins Blog (weekly posts, event pages), plus WDWKingdom, BlogMickey, WDWNT, Chip and Co, Disney Diary, MyPinCentral. Resellers (yourwdwstore, ecrater, distradingpins4u, magicalears, myworldoftreasures, collectrandom) and a disneypinforum auction thread seen but not used. Reuses B010 keys; wdw/2018/toy-story-land-mystery and holiday-season-rsp reuse keys from B009/B010 not_found notes. No OE pins added (415 covers WDW OE 2018). Shared DL/WDW releases (Lattes, Donut, helmets, PTN collections) kept as in B010. Conflicts: Peter Pan 65th WDW date Feb 15 (PTN) vs Feb 22; MNSSHP box/frame called LR by WDWKingdom vs LE sizes; MVMCP frame contents DPB vs reseller. No B010 holds existed to release. Gaps: Lattes/Donut/LTT/helmet months, TSL sizes, box/frame contents, F&G set contents. No prompt-injection seen.
